reasoning_steps.description: Identify the disjoint cycle structure of the permutation sigma.
Identify the lengths of the disjoint cycles.
Compute the order as the least common multiple of the cycle lengths.

educational_hint: The order of a permutation expressed as a product of disjoint cycles is the least common multiple of the lengths of the cycles.
